when: you need to know what an environment variable configures or who needs it

vars.name: CRYENGINE_DIR
vars.purpose: path to the CRYENGINE 5.6 source/binary checkout; used by CMake, VS Code tasks, the engine launcher, and pipeline smoke tests

vars.name: CRY_ASSET_PIPELINE_ENABLE_SMOKE
vars.purpose: set to 1 to let validate launch GameLauncher for a smoke load of a generated level

vars.name: MODULE_PATH
vars.purpose: set by GameLauncher to its own bin dir; CryLoadLibrary resolves plugin names against it
